target_status: Operational targets remain unset pending measured full-size recovery and agreed operating requirements. Local archive round-trip duration is not an RTO or an RPO.

implemented_partial.scope: Explicit synthetic file encryption/decryption, at most 64 MiB plaintext; no database or network access
implemented_partial.encryption: AES-256-GCM, fresh random 96-bit nonce, 128-bit authentication tag, authenticated version header, separate 256-bit key
implemented_partial.restore_guards: Authenticate before creating output; create-only 0600 destination; refuse existing files, final-component symlinks and identical input/output/key paths
implemented_partial.verified: Exact synthetic role/job/audit/attachment bundle bytes survive the wrapper; tamper, wrong-key, truncation and overwrite checks fail safely
implemented_partial.separate_cluster_rehearsal: tools/operations/backup-restore/rehearsal.mjs: representative synthetic role/grants, attachment, pending job and audit; encrypted pg_dump round-trip into separate fresh cluster. Compares rows, schema controls, ownership, grants, role memberships and row-security policies/flags, column definitions/defaults and sequence configuration/consumed identifier state; restored reader sees only its synthetic tenant attachment; missing-FK, unexpected-membership, audit-delete-grant, missing-policy, disabled-RLS and unforced-RLS and column/default/type/identity-rewind/increment negative controls must detect corruption and roll back. Exact-source PostgreSQL CI is required.
implemented_partial.populated_application_rehearsal: tools/accounting-flow/restore-drill.mjs invokes application-recovery.mjs: authenticated encrypted dump of the complete populated regression schema restored into a separate fresh socket-only cluster; compares content/schema fingerprints, reconstructs restricted runtime roles, and executes native source attachment, payment/witness, banking and replacement-history/report checks. This describes the disposable executable, not production or offsite qualification.
implemented_partial.payment_attempt_recovery: New candidate coverage in payment-attempt-acceptance.ts prepares native recorded, no-effect and interrupted pending payment attempts before the dump. The restored runtime must preserve their exact immutable bindings and actor-owned discovery, close the pending request without effects, reject delayed exact-body terminal requests, deduplicate recorded replay, preserve immutable grants/guards and pass scope checks. Parent recovery refuses missing, false or malformed acceptance. Exact-source PostgreSQL CI is still required; this candidate has only local compile/focused validation until then.

existing_database_rehearsal: tools/accounting-flow/restore-drill.mjs verifies a plaintext pg_dump restore inside the disposable test cluster and invokes an authenticated encrypted populated-application restore into a second fresh cluster. Both verify fingerprints and existing runtime restrictions. Neither establishes an off-site destination, real customer restoration or operational recovery targets.
remaining: Qualify the new native payment-attempt pending/no-effect/recorded recovery checks through exact-source populated encrypted fresh-cluster PostgreSQL CI; compilation and pure tests alone do not prove restoration.

Qualify remaining real application runtime flows and persisted extraction/jobs when their actual durable producers exist. The durable_jobs table in the representative rehearsal is a synthetic fixture, not an implemented application job store.
Measure representative end-to-end recovery duration and point-in-time data loss before setting operational targets.
Assign backup/restore/key ownership and define key rotation, emergency recovery, retention and deletion evidence.
Provision off-site destination/access only through the P03-80 owner gate; no provider is connected by this utility.
